system.description:
You generate a vacuum of chakra absorbing the heat from the surrounding area and create a layer of superheated chakra to protect yourself. You gain 4 Temporary hit points and resistance to the triggering instance of damage.

If the triggering damage or any further attacks that target you are melee attacks and the triggering creature is no more than 10 feet away, the attacking creature takes 2d6 Fire damage for each attack, until the end of the current turn. If the triggering damage was cold, this jutsu is dispelled.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage dealt by 1d6 and the temporary hit points gained by +4. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, and the triggering damage type was Fire, you instead gain twice the number of temporary hit points.

If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, this jutsu can be cast as a reaction when you would see an allied creature within 30 feet of you take damage placing a shield of blue flame on them, instead granting them twice the temporary hit points this jutsu would grant you, until the end of the current turn.

If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, this jutsu’s effects last until the beginning of your next turn. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, this jutsu’s casting time becomes Special, which you take when you or an allied creature takes damage. Casting this jutsu in this way no longer costs your reaction.
